top_signals.title: U.S. Military Coordinates With Saudi Oil Tankers on Risky Hormuz Crossings
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia’s shipping giant Bahri has been sending oil tankers through the Strait of Hormuz in coordination with the U.S. military, Khalid Alhammad, president of Bahri Ship Management, said on Tuesday. Saudi Arabia, while boosting loadings and exports out of its Red Sea port of Yanbu, is also looking to raise shipments from within the Persian Gulf through the Strait of Hormuz.   The Saudi firm is working at the government level with the United States to support Hormuz transits, Alhammad said at a Dubai event, as carried by Bloomberg.…

top_signals.title: Bonds Tumble as Hot Inflation Fuels Bets on More Fed Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: The US bond market was hit by one of its biggest selloffs since the meltdown unleashed by President Donald Trump’s tariffs after a bigger-than-expected jump in inflation and hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials cemented speculation that the central bank will resume raising interest rates next month.
